_doc: Curated characterization fixtures for src.matcher (extracted from src.ingest in Phase 1 of refactor-plan-2026-04-29.md). Each entry pins observed match_politicians() / extract_twitter_author_handle() output captured from master commit b0f9871 against data/atmina.db (politician IDs stable per tracked_politicians table). 2026-07-27: baseline deliberately extended for the B2+D2+H matcher package (docs/plans/2026-07-27-matcher-koliziju-plans.md) — cases named d2-*/b2-*/h-* pin the POST-change contract; matcher_politicians.json snapshot refreshed to the 219-row roster (+x_handle).
_invariants: Each case targets a specific code path. Adding a new tracked politician with a previously unseen name MAY change expected_matches; adding one with conflicting first-name MAY change a foreign-firstname guard outcome. Update fixture deliberately when behavior changes.

match_politicians_cases.name: explicit-fullname
match_politicians_cases.comment: Plain full name → unique-form candidate, single subject role.
match_politicians_cases.text: Edgars Rinkēvičs šodien tikās ar premjeru.

match_politicians_cases.name: two-politicians-stable
match_politicians_cases.comment: Two distinct politicians, both unique-form. First (highest count, alphabetic tie) wins subject; rest mentioned.
match_politicians_cases.text: Edgars Rinkēvičs un Evika Siliņa apsprieda budžetu nākamajai sēdei.

match_politicians_cases.name: inflection-genitive-silinya
match_politicians_cases.comment: Latvian genitive ('Siliņas') resolves through _latvian_surname_inflections form generation.
match_politicians_cases.text: Siliņas viedoklis bija skaidrs — pretī šim risinājumam.

match_politicians_cases.name: surname-collision-bare
match_politicians_cases.comment: Bare 'Hermanis' without first-name disambiguator. Both Jānis (13) and Alvis (29) tracked. Truly ambiguous — first-name proximity filter (added 2026-05-13) drops both rather than guess. Old behavior returned both via inflection-not-shared accident; new behavior favors recall loss over false attribution.
match_politicians_cases.text: Hermanis paziņoja, ka atbalsta likumprojektu.

match_politicians_cases.name: surname-collision-resolved-janis
match_politicians_cases.comment: Full name 'Jānis Hermanis' present → unique form match for pid=13. Alvis (29) dropped: shared-surname match without 'Alvis' or 'Alvja/Alvim/Alvi' preceding any Hermanis occurrence in text.
match_politicians_cases.text: Saeimas priekšsēdētāja vietnieks Jānis Hermanis vakar paziņoja par savu lēmumu.

match_politicians_cases.name: surname-collision-resolved-alvis
match_politicians_cases.comment: 'Alvis Hermanis' present → unique form match for pid=29. Jānis (13) dropped for same reason as the mirror case: no Jānis/Jāņa/Jānim/Jāni preceding any Hermanis form.
match_politicians_cases.text: Režisors Alvis Hermanis komentēja teātri.

match_politicians_cases.name: negative-pattern-berzins-cebuvetaji
match_politicians_cases.comment: Andris Bērziņš (146) has negative_pattern 'biedrība Latvijas Ceļu būvētājs' — used to disambiguate from former president of same name. Pattern fires, match rejected.
match_politicians_cases.text: biedrība Latvijas Ceļu būvētājs uzaicināja Andri Bērziņu uz tikšanos.

match_politicians_cases.name: negative-pattern-berzins-eks
match_politicians_cases.comment: Negative pattern 'eks-prezidents' fires — refers to former president, not the tracked ZZS deputy.
match_politicians_cases.text: eks-prezidents Andris Bērziņš pieminēja runā.

match_politicians_cases.name: foreign-firstname-kalnins
match_politicians_cases.comment: 'Krists Kalniņš' — Krists is NOT Rūdolfs (the tracked Kalniņš's first name). foreign-firstname guard rejects.
match_politicians_cases.text: Krists Kalniņš teica, ka komiteja vēl nav lēmusi.

match_politicians_cases.name: foreign-firstname-kols
match_politicians_cases.comment: 'Tomass Alens' is Rihards Kols's negative_pattern (referring to a different person). Match rejected.
match_politicians_cases.text: Tomass Alens un Rihards Kols apsprieda situāciju.

match_politicians_cases.name: common-word-guard-krasta
match_politicians_cases.comment: 'Krasta iela' is street name, not politician 'Krasta' (if any). _surname_has_person_context returns False → no match.
match_politicians_cases.text: Krasta iela tiek pārbūvēta nākamgad.

match_politicians_cases.name: empty-match
match_politicians_cases.comment: Article without any politician reference returns empty list.
match_politicians_cases.text: Šodien Rīgā līs lietus, sola sinoptiķi. Rīt gaidāmas pārmaiņas atmosfēras spiedienā.

match_politicians_cases.name: d2-prefix-kolumbiesi
match_politicians_cases.comment: D2 boundary: auto-inflected 'Kolu' (acc. of Kols, pid=24) is a prefix of 'Kolumbieši' — a word-boundary check must kill the substring bomb. Kols's negative_patterns cover 'Kolumbija'/'Kolumbus' but not this word, so only the code guard stops it (pre-B2D2H the matcher linked pid=24).
match_politicians_cases.text: Kolumbieši svin uzvaru riteņbraukšanas sacensībās.

match_politicians_cases.name: d2-prefix-lacis-komponists
match_politicians_cases.comment: D2 boundary: 'Lāci' (acc. of Lāce, pid=158) is a prefix of masc. 'Lācis' (the composer). Preceded by a lowercase verb, the foreign-first-name veto never fires — only the boundary check stops the Lāce↔Lācis gender-pair class (5 FP docs in the 2026-07 corpus).
match_politicians_cases.text: Mūziklam mūziku sarakstījis Lācis, iestudējums gaidāms decembrī.

match_politicians_cases.name: b2-namesake-smits-alberts
match_politicians_cases.comment: B2 fn_all: declined namesake ('Alberts Šmits ... Šmita') matches TWO forms, so the old count==1 veto gate never fired. The extended veto scans all matched forms when none contains the first name: 'Alberts' is foreign, no correct signal → reject (pid=150 Didzis Šmits linked pre-B2D2H).
match_politicians_cases.text: Hokejists Alberts Šmits pagarināja līgumu ar klubu. Šmita pārstāvis apstiprināja darījumu.

match_politicians_cases.name: b2-namesake-valainis-oskars
match_politicians_cases.comment: -is phantom accusative: 'Valainis' contains generated acc. 'Valaini' as a prefix, inflating count to 2 and bypassing the count==1 veto. D2 boundary kills the nested occurrence, restoring count=1; veto then sees foreign 'Oskars' → reject (pid=25 linked pre-B2D2H).
match_politicians_cases.text: Uzņēmējs Oskars Valainis atklāja jaunu ražotni Jelgavā.

match_politicians_cases.name: b2-namesake-kucinskis-matiss
match_politicians_cases.comment: Same -is phantom + genitive: 'Kučinskis'⊃'Kučinski' plus real 'Kučinska' → count=3 pre-B2D2H. After boundary the genitive occurrence follows a sentence end (skipped) and the nominative is preceded by foreign 'Matīss' → reject (pid=105).
match_politicians_cases.text: Komponists Matīss Kučinskis raksta jaunu simfoniju. Kučinska skaņdarbs izskanēs festivālā.

match_politicians_cases.name: b2-namesake-citskovskis-ugis
match_politicians_cases.comment: Namesake with explicit declension forms in name_forms (Citskovska/Citskovski): count inflation via nested prefix + multiple forms. Boundary + extended veto reject on foreign 'Uģis' (pid=233).
match_politicians_cases.text: Robežsardzes priekšnieks Uģis Citskovskis ziņoja par situāciju uz robežas. Citskovska vietnieks piebilda detaļas.

match_politicians_cases.name: b2-particle-del-toro
match_politicians_cases.comment: Name-particle step: 'del' before 'Toro' is lowercase, so the plain veto sees no foreign name. With the particle rule the word BEFORE the particle ('Isaks') is classified → foreign → reject (pid=234 Arigo Toro linked pre-B2D2H).
match_politicians_cases.text: Riteņbraucējs Isaks del Toro uzvarēja Itālijas tūres posmā.

match_politicians_cases.name: b2-allcaps-isuma-kulbergs
match_politicians_cases.comment: B2 refinement — ALL-CAPS token is never a first-name signal. Pre-B2D2H 'ĪSUMĀ' counted as a foreign first name and the doc was falsely REJECTED; Title-case requirement recovers the match (pid=10 Kulbergs).
match_politicians_cases.text: ĪSUMĀ Kulbergs pieprasīja auditu koncernā.

match_politicians_cases.name: b2-sentence-start-vienlaikus-kulbergs
match_politicians_cases.comment: B2 refinement — 'Vienlaikus' is in the closed-class sentence-adverb STOP set, so its sentence-start capital is not a first-name signal. Pre-B2D2H this falsely rejected the match. (A blanket positional forgiveness was rejected: it reopens the 'Linda Abu Meri' foreign-name-at-sentence-start class.)
match_politicians_cases.text: Valdība piešķīra papildu naudu ceļiem. Vienlaikus Kulbergs sacīja, ka ar to nepietiek.

match_politicians_cases.name: b2-multitoken-firstname-karins
match_politicians_cases.comment: GUARD (same result pre/post): multi-token first name — 'Krišjānis' must exempt the veto for 'Arturs Krišjānis Kariņš' (pid=214). The veto exempt set is built from ALL leading name tokens, not only parts[0]; a naive fn_all extension without this loses the match.
match_politicians_cases.text: Ministru prezidents Krišjānis Kariņš paziņoja par valdības prioritātēm.

match_politicians_cases.name: b2-firstname-decl-ata-svinka
match_politicians_cases.comment: GUARD (same result pre/post): real genitive 'Ata' (Atis) is NOT produced by _latvian_surname_inflections (which yields palatalized 'Aša'); the veto exempt set is deliberately over-generated with both stems. Without it, B2 would read 'Ata' as foreign and lose the match (pid=26).
match_politicians_cases.text: Ata Švinkas lēmums par dzelzceļa projektu izraisīja debates.

match_politicians_cases.name: b2-pronoun-stop-brazes
match_politicians_cases.comment: GUARD (same result pre/post): sentence-initial pronoun 'Tie' before 'Bražes' must not read as a foreign first name (pronoun STOP set + sentence-initial downgrade); pid=15 Baiba Braže.
match_politicians_cases.text: Tie Bražes apzīmējumi izraisīja plašu diskusiju.

match_politicians_cases.name: h-handle-only-ascii-svinka
match_politicians_cases.comment: H: tweet text carries ONLY the registered @handle (ASCII, no diacritic name form present). Pre-B2D2H this doc was invisible to the matcher; registered-handle matching (x_handle ∪ social_accounts) recovers it (pid=26, x_handle atis_svinka).
match_politicians_cases.text: Piekrītu @atis_svinka viedoklim par dzelzceļa projektu.

match_politicians_cases.name: h-handle-rt-kols
match_politicians_cases.comment: GUARD (same result pre/post, different path): pre-B2D2H 'Kols' substring-matched INSIDE '@RihardsKols'; the boundary check kills that accident, and registered-handle matching must recover the same link deliberately (pid=24).
match_politicians_cases.text: RT @RihardsKols: Latvijai jāstiprina austrumu robeža.

match_politicians_cases.name: gold-guard-kolu-bounded
match_politicians_cases.comment: GUARD (same result pre/post): word-bounded accusative 'Kolu' preceded by a lowercase verb is a legitimate mention and must survive both the boundary check and the extended veto (pid=24).
match_politicians_cases.text: Deputāti atbalstīja Kolu ārlietu komisijas vadītāja amatā.

match_politicians_cases.name: d2-multiword-form-not-boundary-checked
match_politicians_cases.comment: GUARD (same result pre/post): boundary applies ONLY to single-word forms. Multi-word 'Abu Meri' nested in dative 'Abu Merim' must still match (pid=161) — boundary-checking phrase forms was measured to lose gold pairs (D vs D2 in the 2026-07-27 eval).
match_politicians_cases.text: Veselības ministram Hosamam Abu Merim jautāja par reformu progresu.
